Radiology Division | Erasmus MC | 10 January 2025
Study: Multiparametric MRI of the prostate
Indication: Follow-up on previous malignancy workup. Presenting PSA stands at 8.3 ng/mL, building on a prior PI-RADS 5 classification.
Observations: The gland spans 38.54 mL. A discrete focus measuring roughly 18 × 14 × 12 mm occupies the left peripheral zone, spanning base to mid-gland. T2 sequences highlight pronounced hypointensity there. Diffusion-weighted imaging confirms marked restriction, mirrored by diminished ADC signal. Post-contrast dynamics show brisk, localized enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. Capsular integrity remains intact with no seminal vesicle involvement or nodal enlargement.
Assessment: PI-RADS 5 lesion within the left peripheral zone. PSAD 0.215 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.86351734.
